**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
There is one more copy of [the Trial](../books.html#53) that I should like to have sent to the Press - i.e., to [Events of the Month](../others.html#69), Mozley’s, 6 Paternoster Row - it is a sort of school room [Athenaeum](../others.html#170) which I wish to help forward
Thanks for your note. I hope nothing will prevent my meeting [Mrs D Macmillan](../persons.html#941) and I shall be glad to talk over your scheme, and see if it comes within my views and capabilities.

The [Golden Deeds](../books.html#51) have been most enjoyable work
Yours faithfully
C.M.

Yonge
